_doc: Proportion samples for the director's look gate (P1-ART-PROPORTIONS, 2026-10-08). Samples only: nothing here changes the frozen rig (rig_contract.json) or the committed camera rig. Each variant scales existing pose bones (uniform scale, no bone added or renamed, so Mixamo clips still drive the skeleton); render_character.py then refits the deformed figure to the reference height (1.78 m) with its feet on the ground. Sizes are the on-screen standing height in 1x pixels under camera_rig.json's scale rule (px_per_m = height_px / (1.78 * cos(pitch))). Frame and pivot are larger than the committed 64x64 cell so a 64 px figure at 55 degrees fits: toes nearer the camera project up to 13 px below the pivot at that pitch.

pose.doc: Sample stance, not the rig: the frozen rest pose holds the arms out and down, which reads as a hunch from a steep camera and hides the proportions. Upper arms hang 12 degrees off vertical and forearms 6 degrees (world directions; left = +X). A rotation like any clip's; no bone changes.

normal_pass.doc: one proportion and size, at both pitches, for the stage's lit-sprite test

review.zoom_doc: 640x360 whole-screen pixel mode shown x3 on a 1080p monitor
